intro: Essence of the Exile is a mysterious transmutation ritual centered on a bubbling, vapor-spewing cauldron. By introducing charms into its liquid depths, travelers trigger a violent reaction that produces a churning lump of molten rock. It represents a potent convergence of volatile reagents and elemental power.
